title: The Last Echo Again
author: Felix Delacroix
blurb: Xanthe Voss, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
